SD24-014.name: Flood Stream
SD24-014.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total cost of 5. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit/Ultimate +4000 BP.

SD24-013.name: King's Command
SD24-013.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Draw three cards, then discard a card from your Hand. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
During this turn, all opposing Cost 4 or more Spirits can't attack.

SD24-015.name: Muscle Wall
SD24-015.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks from opposing Spirits in refreshed state. Or, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

UGENDRAGON-NOVA.name: Mugendragon-Nova
UGENDRAGON-NOVA.effect:
This Spirit card's reduction symbols are also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [SSoul: ∞]
When you are summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains two extra symbols of the same color as the Ultimate card to be summoned.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
Draw a card from your deck. While you control any Ultimate, also, this Spirit gains +4000 BP.

CP14-02.name: Neo-Cerbelord
CP14-02.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 5 or more]

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Target an Ultimate you control, and this Spirit can gain + (targeted Ultimate's BP) BP. If you control any Ultimate, once per turn, by discarding seven cards from your decktop, refresh this Spirit.

SD24-016.name: Spark Burst
SD24-016.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks]
During this turn, every Spirit you control gains +3000 BP. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Treat the cost of every Brave on opposing Brave Spirits as 0, and destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total cost of 5.

SD24-004.name: The CavalryGeneral Philotas

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with [Assault] is blocked by opposing Ultimates, that Spirit gains +10000 BP.

SD24-012.name: The Gate of Gargando
SD24-012.effect:
This card in Trash is unaffected by any effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Either player's Life can only be reduced by one per Spirit within each attack.

[LV2] Flash
By destroying this Nexus, during this turn, give a "Fighting Spirit" family Ultimate you control +5000 BP.

SD24-009.name: The KnowledgeGeneral Ptolemios
SD24-009.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from the opposing decktop. Discard a card from among them. Return the remaining cards to their decktop in any order.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, discard an opposing Burst. If it is a Magic card, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
[utb]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit.
[utb]

SD24-008.name: The SwordGeneral Sution
SD24-008.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

SD24-X01.name: Ultimate-Alexander
SD24-X01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Blue Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, the opponent destroys a Cost 5 or more Spirit they control. [Critical Hit] If the hit card is a Magic card, also, once per turn, refresh this Ultimate.
